name: librechat-mnemonic
description: Enables automatic, project-scoped long-term memory for LibreChat conversations by recalling relevant memories before each turn and writing durable facts after each turn. It integrates via a proxy that resolves project context from MongoDB and exposes MCP tools for explicit memory management.
